payload.title: Blackwell Ultra (B300): NVIDIA AI Chip Evolution and Roadmap
payload.summary: A first-principles analysis of the B300 (Blackwell Ultra) GPU, with projections for the Rubin and Rubin Next platforms through 2030.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.gist: NVIDIA first announced the Rubin platform at Computex 2024 on June 2, 2024, with a planned 2026 launch.

sections.heading: 2. Process Technology Roadmap
sections.gist: By 2030, semiconductor technology will enter the 1nm era, with single-die transistor counts reaching an estimated 200 billion.

sections.heading: 3. Advanced Packaging
sections.gist: TSMC CoWoS roadmap: - 2023: 3.3-reticle, 8 HBM (Blackwell) - 2026: 5.5-reticle, 12 HBM (Rubin / Rubin Ultra) - 2027: >8-reticle, 12 HBM (Rubin Next, possibly 3.5D) - 2026+: Silicon-based SoW (System-on-Wafer), >40-reticle, 60+ HBM

sections.heading: 4. HBM Roadmap
sections.gist: - HBM4: mass production 2025 → Rubin - HBM4E: 2027 → Rubin Next - Samsung developing custom HBM4 for CSPs, targeting 2025 mass production - SK Hynix: 48 GB 16-layer HBM3E (announced at November 2025 SK AI Summit) - Jensen Huang requested S…

sections.heading: 5. Blackwell Ultra (GB300 & B300) Analysis
sections.gist: B300 is a full redesign on 4NP process, delivering **+50% overall FLOPS over B200**.

sections.heading: 6. GB300 Supply Chain Changes
sections.gist: - GB200: complete Bianca board (GPU + Grace CPU + 512 GB LPDDR5X + VRM) + switch tray + copper backplane - GB300: only SXM Puck module with B300 GPU + BGA Grace CPU + Axiado HMC; remaining components sourced by OEM - Second-tier memory: LP…

sections.heading: 7. Rubin / Rubin Ultra Architecture Projections
sections.gist: Evolution path: Hopper (single die) → Blackwell (dual die) → **Rubin (quad die)**.

sections.heading: 8. Rubin NVL288 Projections
sections.gist: Integrating 4 NVL72 units into a single rack yields 4x compute density.
